entries.name: Clinical Precision
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Clean, clinical, calm resume styled like a medical chart record. Each entry is a chart row with a green-railed vital column of monospaced date codes, lab-panel skill cards, and a "chart note" summary. Clinical green accents on white with mint tints. Tailored for doctors, nurses, and healthcare administrators.

entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Academic-meets-exploratory resume styled like a naturalist field notebook. Classic serif narrative, monospaced metadata margins, numbered log sections, and a calm teal-green accent on tinted paper. Tailored for research and sustainability roles.

entries.name: Urban Techno
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Brutalist tech theme with high contrast, dense two-column layout, and bold typography. Black borders, uppercase section titles, and monochrome palette — power through simplicity.

entries.name: Coastal Creative
entries.author: JSON Resume Team

entries.name: Colophon
entries.author: David Nelson
entries.description: Warm, text-first resume theme with editorial typography, semantic HTML, and polished print styles.

entries.name: Creative Confidence
entries.author: Scott Lynde
entries.description: Professional two-column resume theme with dark blue header, profile photo support, and print-optimized layout. Features a clean right sidebar for contact, education, certifications, and skills.

entries.name: Art School Modern
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Avant-garde gallery aesthetic for designers and artists. Oversized Archivo Black display type, an asymmetric off-grid header with a framed photo plate, an editorial Fraunces serif statement, catalogue-numbered sections, and a single vivid vermilion accent.

entries.name: Community Garden
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Beautiful, warm theme celebrating education and community service. Sky blue and garden green colors with prominent certifications and volunteer sections.

entries.name: Industrial Engineer
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Engineering-datasheet aesthetic with a precise grid, monospace technical labels, spec-table contact block, part-number section headers, and dimension-line rules. Drafting-blue with safety-orange accents for dense, legible data presentation.

entries.name: Brutalist
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: Raw concrete brutalism with heavy 4px black rules, oversized uppercase Archivo Black headings, hard edges, monospace spec labels, numbered sections, and offset block-shadows. Stark black-on-white with a single harsh safety-yellow accent.

entries.name: Art Deco
entries.author: JSON Resume Team
entries.description: 1920s Gatsby elegance with a symmetric centered masthead on a deep midnight-and-emerald jewel panel, metallic-gold accents, geometric chevron and sunburst dividers, and a high-contrast Cinzel didone-style display serif over a graceful Cormorant Garamond body.
